summary: cpu_capacity formula: cpus * fork_per_cpu with a baseline of four forks per core, so a 4-core system gives 16 forks; fork_per_cpu is SYSTEM_TASK_FORKS_CPU (default 4). Useful because Ansible workloads are often processor-bound.
questions: How is cpu_capacity calculated in automation controller?
How many forks per CPU core does AAP allow?
How many forks does a 4 core controller node get?

answer_card.title: CPU-based capacity (cpu_capacity)
answer_card.answer_md:
Controller computes CPU capacity as:

```
cpus * fork_per_cpu
```

The baseline is 4 forks per core, so a 4-core node gives `4 * 4 = 16` forks. Change `fork_per_cpu` with the `SYSTEM_TASK_FORKS_CPU` setting (default `4`).
